claims.content: If a search results in no matches, the system displays a 'No Results Found' page which includes a 'Popular Searches' links section with static lists of popular gemstone and jewelry searches, and a dynamically updated list of search terms or phrases using Omniture data.
If a user clicks on a link that contains no product (e.g., collectibles), the user is served a 'no results found' page.

If a user attempts to place a bid via the QuickBid button or by clicking within a product module but is not signed in, the user will be prompted to sign in. After completing the sign-in process, the user will be returned to the catalog page or delivered to the Product Details page respectively.
If the search results in multiple items found, a category / search result page loads, using the default catalog view page.
If there is only one search match, the product details page loads.
The user is presented with search results or a browse page containing active auction items that have an available image to display.
